Row.Text:
Know your trade network at a glance.
Connected Settlements adds a simple “N Settlements Connected” readout to a city or town's Production / Purchase panel — the very screen where you decide what to build and which specialization a town should take. No more guessing how far your roads and routes actually reach: the number is right there while you plan.
[h3]What it does[/h3] [list] [*] Shows how many settlements are connected to the selected city or town [*] Updates instantly as you flip between cities with the panel's arrows [*] Shows “0 Settlements Connected” for a freshly founded city, so you always know it's working [/list]
[h3]Safe and lightweight[/h3] [list] [*] UI-only — it reads game state and never changes the rules [*] Does not affect saved games; safe to add or remove anytime [*] Multiplayer-friendly [/list]
[h3]Inspiration[/h3] This mod was inspired by the excellent [b]City Hall[/b] by beezany, whose deep city-management panels showed what's possible with Civ VII's UI — and made us want a tiny, focused version of just the connected-settlements count. If you like this, go check out City Hall for the full experience.
Built for Civilization VII build 1.4.0. Open source — feedback and contributions welcome.
